findings.summary: Redirect bullets for Q10 sit at the end of the Q9 page with no heading, before the Q10 heading on the next page.
findings.evidence: Final block on the page: "Clients may turn a POST into GET on 301 or 302" / "Use `308` when an API endpoint moves for good", directly after the Q9 table. Q10 starts on page 3.
findings.fix: Remove this bullet list from page 2. Page 3 already covers the same points (POST-to-GET trap, 308 for permanent moves, redirect caching), so nothing is lost.
Run the fit pass — it adds material from the book without removing anything.

findings.summary: Q24 is split across pages: sliding window is compared against token bucket before it is explained, and the comparison table has no heading.
findings.evidence: Page 9 Q24 shows only the token-bucket diagram. Page 10 opens with a headingless table "Token bucket / Sliding log / Sliding counter / Fixed window", and "sliding window" is never defined.
findings.fix: Put a short sliding-window explanation (or diagram) under Q24 on page 9. Give the page-10 algorithm table a heading such as "Rate limit algorithms compared", placed right after it.

findings.summary: The blanket rule "never retry 4xx" contradicts page 4, which says 408 and 429 are retryable.
findings.evidence: "Retry 5xx with backoff, never 4xx. Send `Retry-After` on 503." versus page 4 table: "408 yes", "429 yes". Page 3 also lists 500 as "maybe".
findings.fix: Reword to "Retry 502/503/504 with backoff and 4xx only for 408/429; never retry other 4xx".

findings.summary: The question-range suffix in the title wraps onto its own line, so the title block looks broken.

findings.summary: Credentials alone do not trigger a CORS preflight. A custom header or a non-simple method or content type does.
findings.fix: Replace with "Triggers: any non-safelisted header, e.g. `Authorization`". Add a note that credentials change the response rules (no `*` origin) but do not cause a preflight.

findings.fix: Change the reference to "see Authentication: JWT and OAuth 2.0". Move the CSRF callout to the CSRF section on page 8.
